decisions: Clarify whether the box is for retail display, e-commerce shipping, gift presentation or protective transit.
Prepare product dimensions, packed weight, quantity range, material direction and artwork status before requesting a quote.
If inserts, windows, sleeves, handles or special finishes are needed, list them separately so the structure can be reviewed accurately.
